dedupe_keys.name: arise agent based renewables model for integrated sustainable energy household pv investment and policy impact model for indonesia

description: ARISE is an agent-based energy model built to assess renewable energy policy in developing countries, first for Indonesia. The CoMSES Net release read on 2026-09-28 (version 1.10.0, peer reviewed, DOI 10.25937/k6xm-gf50, first published on 5 October 2018 and modified on 5 December 2024) describes a hybrid model that combines engineering, social, microeconomic, macroeconomic and environmental views, with features of developing countries such as urban-rural differences, income inequality and lack of electricity access. The current scope is how a proposed policy affects household decisions to invest in solar panels, with estimates of the resulting macroeconomic output and environmental effects; a switch sets whether a financing sector is available. It is written in NetLogo. Access is free download under the Academic Free Licence 3.0. Caveats: the analysis is limited to household PV, and parameters are Indonesian. It supports capacity planning of distributed solar in weak grids, such as testing subsidy or financing schemes. Related record: PowerGen-ABM by the same authors models Indonesian power plant expansion.
name: ARISE (Agent-based Renewables model for Integrated Sustainable Energy): household PV investment and policy impact model for Indonesia
outputs: macroeconomic and environmental impacts of the policy
provider: Muhammad Indra Al Irsyad, Anthony Halog and Rabindra Nepal (CoMSES Net)
